# Cryptonic Area

> Cryptonic Area is a global cybersecurity and technology community focused on practical learning, hands-on projects and real-world skill development in ethical hacking, WAPT (Web Application Penetration Testing), OSINT, network security and cyber crime investigation. 5000+ members, 400+ trained interns, 40+ countries reached.

Founder and CEO: Karndeep Baror (Red Team Operator, Penetration Tester, APT Intelligence).
Community Research & Lead: Saniya Yadav.
Contact: info@cryptonicarea.site

## Main pages
- [Home](https://cryptonicarea.site/): Overview, programs, internships, events, reviews
- [About](https://cryptonicarea.site/about): Company and community overview
- [Programs](https://cryptonicarea.site/programs): WAPT program, internships, campus ambassador program

## Topics
Ethical hacking, WAPT, OSINT, network security, cyber crime investigation, digital forensics, cybersecurity internships, campus ambassador program, 1:1 mentor calls, business cybersecurity services.
